name: dotfmt
description: Formatter for config, data, markup, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript/JSX, CSS and Tailwind; errors-only diagnostics, never lints or hints

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace settings cannot choose the dotfmt or language server binary or the TypeScript compiler. Type-aware checks and unsafe fixes stay disabled; formatting still works.

virtualWorkspaces.description: dotfmt resolves configuration from files on disk.

dotfmt.typeAware.markdownDescription: Run the TypeScript compiler for the nearest project. **Errors only**: type errors become diagnostics, and unused-code or lint findings are never published as diagnostics.

dotfmt.diagnostics.syntax.markdownDescription: Publish fatal syntax and configuration errors. Set to `false` to stop syntax and configuration diagnostics for this resource; TypeScript compiler errors still follow `dotfmt.typeAware`.

enumDescriptions: Check every file in the TypeScript project
dotfmt.diagnostics.tscScope.markdownDescription: Which files receive TypeScript compiler errors when `dotfmt.typeAware` is on. `open` keeps diagnostics to open documents; `project` publishes errors for the whole project.

dotfmt.diagnostics.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds before TypeScript checks run again after an edit.

dotfmt.typescript.tsdk.markdownDescription: Path to a TypeScript installation: the package directory (`node_modules/typescript`), its `lib` directory (`node_modules/typescript/lib`), or `tsc.js` itself. Empty auto-discovers the project's compiler. The workspace value is ignored in untrusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Apply safe fixes and formatting on save
Apply safe fixes, unused-local removal and formatting on save; unused exports stay unless enabled explicitly
dotfmt.fixes.onSave.markdownDescription: Apply configured fixes during `textDocument/willSaveWaitUntil` and full-document formatting. Range formatting, on-type formatting, paste and formatting-only code action requests never apply fixes. `unsafe` adds unused-local removal; it never removes unused exports unless `remove_unused_exports` is set explicitly in `dotfmt.dotfile`, and export removal requires a trusted workspace. `remove_unused_parameters` is diagnose-only.

dotfmt.codeActions.unusedExports.markdownDescription: Offer **Remove unused export (unsafe)** quick fixes from project-wide analysis. This is an unsafe quick fix and requires a trusted workspace; unused exports are never published as diagnostics.

dotfmt.formatExtra.markdownDescription: Free-form dotfmt configuration overlay for options not listed under `dotfmt.format.*` or advanced combinations. It uses the `dotfmt.dotfile` object shape (`global`, language blocks, `included_files`, `excluded_files`) and has lower precedence than `dotfmt.format.*`; a key set in both uses the `dotfmt.format.*` value. `null` or absent inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.path.description: dotfmt CLI binary shown in status and doctor; empty uses the bundled one

dotfmt.server.path.description: dotfmt language server binary; empty uses the bundled one

dotfmt.trace.server.description: Trace LSP communication with the dotfmt language server in the dotfmt trace output channel; set that channel's log level to Trace to see the messages

dotfmt.format.global.width.markdownDescription:
Line width used where a language wraps: BibTeX and LaTeX prose, Lua lines, Markdown tables, YAML flow collections, TOML arrays and inline tables, and TypeScript, CSS and HTML output. Accepted and ignored by env, ignore, ini and plist; CSS, HTML and TypeScript cap it at 320.

Default: each language's own value — 80 everywhere except Lua, which uses 120. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.global.indent.markdownDescription:
Spaces per indentation level. Most languages accept 1 to 16, CSS, HTML and TypeScript accept 0 to 24, and the JSON block also takes `-1` for tabs or `0` for compact JSON. Env, ignore and markdown ignore it.

Default: each language's own value — 2 spaces, except ini, which keeps its dialect's indentation. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.global.final_newline.markdownDescription:
Write a trailing newline at the end of every file.

Default: each language's own value — `true` for JSON, TOML, YAML, plist, env, ini, CSS, HTML and TypeScript, and `false` for Bib, conf, ignore, LaTeX, Lua and Markdown. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.global.repair.markdownDescription:
Repair near-valid input before formatting instead of reporting a syntax error. Only JSON/JSONC/JSONL, Lua, TOML and YAML implement repairs; the other languages leave malformed input unchanged.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.global.quote_style.markdownDescription:
Quote character preference for the languages that rewrite quoting: Lua and YAML strings, plus TypeScript, CSS and HTML. JSON always emits double quotes, and bib, conf, env, ignore, ini, LaTeX, Markdown, plist and TOML preserve the source quoting.

Default: each language's own preference — `double` for TypeScript, CSS and HTML, and `auto-prefer-double` for Lua and YAML. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

Default: the language's `dotfmt.dotfile` state — the engine starts with every language disabled, and the shipped configuration enables all of them except JavaScript. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.include.markdownDescription:
Additional gitignore-style filename mappings for this language, one pattern per entry, on top of its built-in extensions. An explicitly empty list resets the inherited mappings.

Default: no additional mappings. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.exclude.markdownDescription:
Gitignore-style patterns skipped for this language only, one pattern per entry. An explicitly empty list resets the inherited patterns.

Default: nothing excluded. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.repair.markdownDescription:
Repair near-valid input in this language before formatting. Only JSON/JSONC/JSONL, Lua, TOML and YAML implement repairs; the other languages leave malformed input unchanged.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.indent.markdownDescription:
Spaces per indentation level.

Default: `2`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.width.markdownDescription:
Target line width; arrays and inline tables expand beyond it.

Default: `80`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.allowed_blank_lines.markdownDescription:
Maximum consecutive blank lines kept between elements.

Default: `1`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.final_newline.markdownDescription:
Write a trailing newline at the end of the file.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.line_endings.markdownDescription:
Line endings written for the whole file: `unix` (LF) or `windows` (CRLF).

Default: `unix`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.align_entries.markdownDescription:
Align `=` within contiguous groups of entries.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.align_comments.markdownDescription:
Align trailing comments within contiguous groups.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.align_single_comments.markdownDescription:
Also align a lone trailing comment in a group.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.array_trailing_comma.markdownDescription:
Write a trailing comma on multi-line arrays.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.array_auto_expand.markdownDescription:
Expand arrays that do not fit the configured width.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.array_auto_collapse.markdownDescription:
Collapse arrays that fit on one line.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.compact_arrays.markdownDescription:
Omit padding inside single-line arrays.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.compact_inline_tables.markdownDescription:
Omit padding inside inline tables.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.compact_entries.markdownDescription:
Omit spaces around `=`.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.inline_table_expand.markdownDescription:
Expand values nested in inline tables that do not fit the width.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.indent_tables.markdownDescription:
Indent nested table headers and their contents by depth.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.indent_entries.markdownDescription:
Indent entries under a table header by one level.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.reorder_keys.markdownDescription:
Sort direct entries within a contiguous group by key.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.toml.format_comments.markdownDescription:
Insert a space after `#` where one is missing.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.jsx_quote_style.markdownDescription:
Quote character for JSX attribute values.

Default: `double`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.quote_propertie.markdownDescription:

dotfmt.format.typescript.semicolons.markdownDescription:
Write statement-terminating semicolons.

Default: `always`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.trailing_commas.markdownDescription:
Where to write trailing commas in multi-line lists.

Default: `all`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.arrow_parenthes.markdownDescription:
Parenthesize single-parameter arrow functions.

Default: `always`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.bracket_spacing.markdownDescription:
Write spaces inside `{ }`.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.bracket_same_li.markdownDescription:
Put the closing `>` of a multi-line JSX tag on the last attribute's line.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.attribute_posit.markdownDescription:

Default: `auto`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.expand.markdownDescription:
Object literals: `auto`/`preserve` keep an object multi-line when the source wrote a newline after `{`, and `never`/`collapse` also collapse it onto one line when it fits.

Default: `auto`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.object_wrap.markdownDescription:
Alias of `expand`, matching the Prettier `objectWrap` spelling.

Default: `auto`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.jsdoc.markdownDescription:
Format JSDoc comment blocks.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.embedded_css.markdownDescription:
Format CSS inside CSS-in-JS template literals with the CSS formatter.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.sort_imports.markdownDescription:
Sort import statements.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.import_order.markdownDescription:
Import sort direction.

Default: `asc`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.import_internal.markdownDescription:
Module prefixes treated as internal imports when grouping. Arrays are joined with commas.

Default: `~/` and `@/`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.import_side_eff.markdownDescription:
Sort side-effect imports together with the other groups.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.import_newlines.markdownDescription:
Write a blank line between import groups.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.import_partitio.markdownDescription:
Keep the source's blank lines between import groups.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

Keep the source's comments between import groups.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.import_groups.markdownDescription:
Custom import groups: `|` separates groups and `+` joins entries in one group, for example `type+builtin | external | parent+sibling`. `default`, `perfectionist`, `biome` and `none` keep the built-in order.

Default: the built-in group order: builtin, external, internal/subpath, parent/sibling/index, style, then unknown. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind.markdownDescription:
Tailwind class sorting: `auto` engages only when the file or project uses Tailwind. `true` and `false` are accepted aliases for `on` and `off`.

Default: `auto`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_order.markdownDescription:
Where the class order comes from: the project's own Tailwind, the Rust pattern sorter, or `auto` (project when available, Rust otherwise).

Default: `auto`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_functi.markdownDescription:
Functions whose arguments hold class lists. Arrays are joined with commas.

Default: the formatter's built-in function names. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_attrib.markdownDescription:
Attributes whose values hold class lists. Arrays are joined with commas.

Default: the formatter's built-in attribute names. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_dedupe.markdownDescription:
Remove duplicate classes from a class list.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_merge.markdownDescription:
Collapse conflicting utilities with `tailwind-merge`. Off by default because merging can change rendering.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_styles.markdownDescription:
Stylesheet that declares the Tailwind theme used for ordering.

Default: unset — the project's stylesheet is discovered. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.tailwind_config.markdownDescription:
Tailwind config file used for ordering.

Default: unset — the project's Tailwind config is discovered. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.fixes.markdownDescription:
Preset for format-time fixes: `off`, `safe` (unused imports, type-only conversion, organize imports) or `unsafe` (safe plus unused locals). `none` and `all` are aliases; export removal is never implied.

Default: `off`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.remove_unused_i.markdownDescription:
Remove unused imports; a bare side-effect-only import keeps its side effect.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.remove_unused_e.markdownDescription:
Remove project-wide unused exports. Unsafe: needs project analysis and a trusted workspace.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.remove_unused_l.markdownDescription:
Remove unused local variables (unsafe).

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.remove_unused_p.markdownDescription:
Diagnose-only: `--diagnose` reports unused parameters, and formatting never removes them.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.convert_type_on.markdownDescription:
Convert imports used only as types to `import type`.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.organize_import.markdownDescription:
Sort and group import runs, applying their import fixes.

Default: `false`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.type_aware.markdownDescription:
Run the project's `tsc --noEmit` once and keep errors only. Project checks require a trusted workspace.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.

dotfmt.format.typescript.verify.markdownDescription:
Fail when formatting would remove code compared with the input.

Default: `true`. Unset here inherits from `dotfmt.dotfile`.
